{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Confirm the number of non-null values in body_mass_g
num_non_null = penguins['body_mass_g'].notnull().sum()
print(f"Number of non-null body_mass_g values: {num_non_null}")

# Compute the mean, which automatically excludes NaN by default
mean_body_mass = penguins['body_mass_g'].mean()
print(f"Mean body mass (grams): {mean_body_mass}")"}
